text:
Omar: Quick sync — retention milestone for console-observability lands next Tue (2026-03-24). We need clear owners for: dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention enforcement. Blocked items: trace-storage migration (INF-412) and analytics schema changes. Who can own each piece? @mentions welcome.

Jess: I can own dashboards. Will scope which panels to keep vs roll-off and post a diff by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:

Liam: I'll take tracing hooks. Need ETA from infra on trace-storage cutover — otherwise hooks will be delayed. Ping @Connor.

Connor: INF-412 is on my plate. Proposed migration window Wed 2026-03-25 02:00-06:00 UTC. Need confirmation on retention policy switch and a rollback plan. :eyes: Glad to coordinate.

Priya: I can lead error-analysis views. Two asks: 1) a sample query for edge-case errors, 2) confirm whether KV cache retention affects logs export.

Jess: Note — dashboards depend on new event schema (ANALYTICS-88). @Tara can you confirm status?

Tara: Confirming ANALYTICS-88 is on track. Schema migration planned Mon 2026-03-23. Theres a small breaking change to event.field_x; dashboards will need a minor panel update.

Omar: Action items recap: Jess -> dashboards diff by Fri, Liam -> tracing hooks PR by Mon, Priya -> error views query + test dataset, Connor -> confirm migration window + rollback plan. Add PR links and tag me. We also need a canary for retention enforcement — who can add a lightweight canary job?

Priya: I'll add the canary job. Suggest namespace `staging-retention-canary`. Will open PR and include test dataset.

Connor: Rollback plan notes — snapshot current trace index before migration. If anything fails revert to snapshot + DNS switch. I'll add a runbook and rollback checklist to INF-412.

Liam: Minimal canary command I'll wire into the dashboard: 
```
kubectl run retention-canary --image=redwood/retention-check:prod --namespace=staging-retention -- \n  --check-traces --sample=1000
```
Will emit metrics to `canary.retention` metric series.

Jess: Heads-up: dashboards PR is blocked on a query change — PR #4521. @Priya can you review the panel queries? tag:needs-review

Priya: :+1: will review PR #4521 today and leave comments.

Omar: If infra confirms migration schedule, we'll gate the rollout on that. If INF-412 slips, fallback is to delay retention enforcement by 2 weeks and keep current retention settings.

Tara: Small downstream note — integrations teams might need a debounce window. Analytics will post a migration announcement in #integrations and update the changelog.

Connor: INF-412 updated with migration window and rollback steps: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-412

infra-bot: Deployment scheduled for INF-412 — 2026-03-25 02:00-06:00 UTC (maintenance window).

Omar: Thanks all. I'll compile owners into the milestone doc after PRs land. Ping here if anything slips or if you want the milestone split into smaller rollouts.

Jess: Quick FYI — I added a checklist to the dashboards PR with panels to sunset. Link in the PR.

Liam: Will open tracing hooks PR and include basic integration test against the canary metric.

Priya: PR for canary job opened: #4580 — includes test dataset and runbook.

Omar: Perfect. Last ask — when you open PRs add the milestone tag `obs-retention-2026-03` so I can aggregate.

Jess: done.

Connor: Added `obs-retention-2026-03` to INF-412 and runbook attached.

Omar: Closing loop — I'll update the milestone doc tomorrow morning with owners + dates. If anything changes, update this thread. Thanks everyone.
